verdict.rationale: monday.com documents several natural-language control surfaces. Users can message, assign, or @mention agents to kick off work (monday-docs-11, monday-docs-19) and describe a workflow in their own words to create an agent (monday-docs-14), with examples like "Score our open deals and send proposals" (monday-docs-32). It can also be driven from Claude or ChatGPT through an official hosted MCP (monday-docs-1, monday-docs-30, monday-probe-2), and words can be turned into apps or deployments from chat (monday-docs-34, monday-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, in-depth docs beyond marketing copy, and clarity on how much of core board and item operations natural language can drive.
